## InputNumber 数字输入框插件

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/plugins/input-number

# InputNumber 数字输入框

`@ew-color-picker/input-number` 包含两部分：

1. **插件** `ewColorPickerInputNumber`：随聚合包自动注册，把一个数字输入框挂到面板底部行；
2. **组件** `InputNumber`：可独立使用的受控数字输入组件，ColorMode 插件在 RGB/HSL 模式下用它构建分通道输入组。

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 包 | `@ew-color-picker/input-number` |
| `pluginName` | `ewColorPickerInputNumber` |
| `applyOrder` | `Post` |
| 挂载点 | `panelContainer` → `.ew-color-picker-bottom-row` |
| 访问实例 | `core.plugins.ewColorPickerInputNumber` |

::: warning 必须引入额外样式
数字输入框的样式在独立文件中：

```ts
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/input-number.css'
```

只引入 `index.css` 会导致输入框无样式。
:::

## 插件配置

| 配置 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | 禁用所有由该插件管理的数字输入框 |

插件读取核心的 `disabled` 并同步给已创建的输入框。

## 插件方法

```ts
const inputNumberPlugin = picker.plugins.ewColorPickerInputNumber
```

| 方法 | 签名 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `createInputNumber` | `(options: InputNumberOptions) => InputNumber` | 创建一个数字输入组件实例 |
| `updateOptions` | `() => void` | 重新读取核心配置并把 `disabled` 应用到所有实例 |
| `run` | `() => void` | 创建默认实例并挂到底部行 |
| `destroy` | `() => void` | 销毁全部实例并清空引用 |

## InputNumber 组件

```ts
import { InputNumber } from '@ew-color-picker/input-number'
```

### 构造配置

| 配置 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | `0` | 初始值 |
| `min` | `number` | `-Infinity` | 最小值 |
| `max` | `number` | `Infinity` | 最大值 |
| `step` | `number` | `1` | 步进值 |
| `precision` | `number` | `0` | 小数位数 |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | 禁用 |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | 占位符 |
| `size` | `'small' \| 'default' \| 'large'` | `'default'` | 尺寸 |
| `onChange` | `(value: number) => void` | — | 值变化回调（防抖 300ms） |
| `onBlur` | `(value: number) => void` | — | 失焦回调 |
| `onFocus` | `(event: FocusEvent) => void` | — | 聚焦回调 |

### 组件方法

| 方法 | 签名 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `getValue` | `() => number` | 读取当前值 |
| `setValue` | `(value: number) => void` | 设置值（会按 `min`/`max`/`precision` 规整） |
| `setDisabled` | `(disabled: boolean) => void` | 切换禁用态 |
| `getElement` | `() => HTMLElement` | 获取根 DOM，便于自行挂载 |
| `destroy` | `() => void` | 解绑事件并移除 DOM |

### 独立使用示例

```ts
import { InputNumber } from '@ew-color-picker/input-number'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/input-number.css'

const num = new InputNumber({
  value: 50,
  min: 0,
  max: 100,
  step: 1,
  precision: 0,
  placeholder: '饱和度',
  onChange: (v) => console.log('新值', v),
})

document.body.appendChild(num.getElement())
```

::: tip 初始化不触发 onChange
构造时会直接同步显示值，但**不会**调用 `onChange`，避免实例创建阶段误改颜色。只有用户交互才会触发。
:::

## DOM 结构

```html
<div class="ew-input-number ew-input-number--default">
  <input class="ew-input-number__input" type="text" inputmode="decimal" />
  <div class="ew-input-number__buttons">
    <button class="ew-input-number__button ew-input-number__button--up"></button>
    <button class="ew-input-number__button ew-input-number__button--down"></button>
  </div>
</div>
```

| 类名 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `.ew-input-number` | 根节点 |
| `.ew-input-number--small` / `--default` / `--large` | 尺寸 |
| `.ew-input-number--focused` | 聚焦态 |
| `.ew-input-number--disabled` | 禁用态 |
| `.ew-input-number__input` | 输入框 |
| `.ew-input-number__buttons` | 上下步进按钮容器 |
| `.ew-input-number__button--up` / `--down` | 步进按钮 |

## 与 ColorMode 的关系

ColorMode 在 RGB/HSL 模式下会：

1. 调用 `createInputNumber` 创建 R/G/B/A 或 H/S/L/A 输入组；
2. 把多个 `InputNumber` 放进 `.ew-color-picker-inputs-group`；
3. 任一输入变化后合成颜色并调用 `core.setColor()`。

因此调色时不需要手动拼装这四个输入框。

## 完整示例

```ts
const picker = new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  defaultColor: '#f59e0b',
  defaultMode: 'rgb',
})

picker.on('change', (color) => {
  console.log('RGB 输入组改色：', color)
  // r/g/b 实时值
  console.log(picker.hsvaColor)
})
```

## 相关

- [ColorMode 颜色模式](./color-mode.md)
- [Input 颜色输入框](./input.md)
- [样式与类名](../api/styles.md)

## Input 颜色输入框插件

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/plugins/input

# Input 颜色输入框

`ewColorPickerInput` 渲染一个文本输入框，允许用户直接键入颜色值。输入合法颜色后回车或失焦即改色；非法输入不会污染当前颜色。

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 包 | `@ew-color-picker/input` |
| `pluginName` | `ewColorPickerInput` |
| `applyOrder` | `Post` |
| 挂载点 | `panelContainer` |
| 访问实例 | `core.plugins.ewColorPickerInput` |

## 配置项

| 配置 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hasInput` | `boolean` | `true` | `false` 时不渲染输入框 |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | 禁用输入框 |
| `changeColor` | `(rgba: string) => void` | — | 输入合法颜色并改色后的回调，参数为 `rgba()` 字符串 |

> 输入框的显示内容由当前模式决定：Hex 模式显示 hex，RGB 模式显示 `rgb()/rgba()`，HSL 模式显示 `hsl()/hsla()`。模式切换由 [ColorMode](./color-mode.md) 管理。

## 实例方法

```ts
const input = picker.plugins.ewColorPickerInput
```

| 方法 / 属性 | 签名 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enableInput` | `(enable = true) => void` | 显示/隐藏输入框 |
| `hasInput` | `boolean`（getter/setter） | setter 会立即渲染或移除 DOM |
| `setValue` | `(value: string) => void` | 直接设置输入框文本（不改颜色） |
| `getValue` | `() => string` | 读取输入框当前文本 |
| `setDisabled` | `(disabled: boolean) => void` | 切换禁用态，会同步 `ew-input-disabled` 类 |
| `update` | `(color: string) => void` | 按当前模式格式化并写入输入框 |
| `onInputColor` | `(value: string) => void` | 处理输入值；内部防抖 300ms |
| `input` | `HTMLInputElement \| null` | 输入框 DOM |

### 典型用法

```ts
// 让输入框显示当前颜色（内部已自动处理，一般无需手动调用）
picker.plugins.ewColorPickerInput.update(picker.getColor())

// 直接读取用户输入
console.log(picker.plugins.ewColorPickerInput.getValue())

// 禁用
picker.plugins.ewColorPickerInput.setDisabled(true)
```

## 输入校验

| 输入 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `#f00`、`#ff0000`、`#ff000080` | 合法，按当前插件组合转换为 rgba 或 hex |
| `rgb(255,0,0)`、`rgba(255,0,0,0.5)` | 合法 |
| `hsl(0,100%,50%)`、`hsla(...)` | 合法 |
| 空字符串 | 合法（表示清空颜色） |
| 其它 | 非法，不触发改色；部分场景会 `warn` |

输入事件防抖 300ms，避免每个按键都触发整棵插件树的同步。

## 事件与回调

改色成功后：

```ts
core.setColor(rgbaColor)
core.trigger('change', rgbaColor)
options.changeColor?.(rgbaColor)
```

监听 `change`：

```ts
picker.on('change', (color) => console.log('输入框改色：', color))
```

## DOM 结构

```html
<div class="ew-color-picker-input-container ew-color-picker-input-container-flex">
  <input class="ew-color-picker-input" type="text" />
</div>
```

禁用时输入框会追加 `ew-input-disabled`。

## 完整示例

```ts
const picker = new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  defaultColor: '#0ea5e9',
  hasInput: true,
  changeColor: (rgba) => console.log('用户输入了：', rgba),
})

picker.on('change', (color) => {
  console.log('当前颜色', color)
})
```

## 相关

- [ColorMode 颜色模式](./color-mode.md) — 决定输入框显示格式
- [InputNumber 数字输入框](./input-number.md) — RGB/HSL 分通道输入

## Panel 颜色面板插件

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/plugins/panel

# Panel 颜色面板

`ewColorPickerPanel` 负责最核心的取色区域：一张二维渐变面板，横轴是饱和度（S），纵轴是明度（V），拖动光标即可改色。

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 包 | `@ew-color-picker/panel` |
| `pluginName` | `ewColorPickerPanel` |
| `applyOrder` | `Post` |
| 挂载点 | `panelContainer` |
| 访问实例 | `core.plugins.ewColorPickerPanel` |

## 配置项

| 配置 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hasPanel` | `boolean` | `true` | `false` 时不渲染二维面板 |
| `ewColorPickerPanel` | `boolean` | `true` | 兼容写法：`false` 等价于关闭面板，其余面板配置请直接放在顶层 |
| `hueDirection` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'vertical'` | 影响面板计算宽度（水平布局更宽） |
| `alphaDirection` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'vertical'` | 同上，两者都水平时面板宽 320px |
| `autoPanelPosition` | `boolean` | `false` | 是否根据触发器位置自动定位面板 |
| `panelPlacement` | `string` | `'bottom'` | 自动定位时的方向，见下表 |
| `appendTo` | `string \| HTMLElement` | `undefined` | 把面板容器挂载到外部容器（如 `document.body`），避免被 `overflow` 裁剪 |
| `hasBox` | `boolean` | `true` | 自动定位需要显示 Box 触发器（读取其尺寸） |
| `alpha` | `boolean` | 由插件是否存在决定 | 有无透明度插件会影响默认颜色格式 |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | 禁用后拖拽不生效 |

### panelPlacement 取值

| 方向 | 对齐 |
| --- | --- |
| `top-start` / `top` / `top-end` | 面板在上方 |
| `bottom-start` / `bottom` / `bottom-end` | 面板在下方 |
| `left-start` / `left` / `left-end` | 面板在左侧 |
| `right-start` / `right` / `right-end` | 面板在右侧 |

带 `-start` / `-end` 时按触发器边缘对齐，不带后缀时居中对齐。面板与触发器间距固定 5px，超出视口会自动翻转/内收。

### 面板宽度规则

| hue 方向 | alpha 方向 | 面板宽度 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 垂直 | 垂直 | 285px |
| 水平 | 垂直（或反之） | 约 302px |
| 水平 | 水平 | 320px |

高度固定 180px，通过 CSS 变量 `--panel-width` / `--panel-height` 注入。

## 实例方法

```ts
const panel = picker.plugins.ewColorPickerPanel
```

| 方法 | 签名 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `render` | `() => void` | 重建面板 DOM（会移除旧面板） |
| `updateCursorPosition` | `(saturation: number, value: number) => void` | 把光标移动到 S/V 对应位置（0–100） |
| `updateColor` | `(saturation: number, value: number) => void` | 按 S/V 计算新颜色并调用 `core.setColor()`，随后 `trigger('change')` |
| `updateHueBg` | `(hue?: number) => void` | 更新面板纯色底；不传则取当前颜色色相 |
| `calculateContainerSize` | `() => void` | 计算容器尺寸（隐藏状态下会临时离屏测量） |
| `handleAutoPosition` | `() => void` | 按 `panelPlacement` 计算并应用面板位置 |
| `calculatePosition` | `(position, align, boxWidth, boxHeight) => { left, top }` | 纯计算，不写 DOM |
| `adjustForViewport` | `(root, left, top) => { left, top }` | 视口边界修正 |
| `destroy` | `() => void` | 移除面板与事件 |

### 属性

| 属性 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `panel` | `HTMLElement \| null` | 面板根节点 |
| `cursor` | `HTMLElement \| null` | 光标节点 |
| `whitePanel` / `blackPanel` | `HTMLElement \| null` | 白/黑渐变层 |
| `panelWidth` / `panelHeight` | `number` | 当前面板尺寸 |
| `isHueHorizontal` / `isAlphaHorizontal` | `boolean` | 方向标记 |
| `isDragging` | `boolean` | 是否正在拖拽 |

### 手动改色

```ts
// 饱和度 50%，明度 80%
picker.plugins.ewColorPickerPanel.updateColor(50, 80)
```

注意 `updateColor` 内部已经调用了 `core.setColor()` 并触发 `change`，不需要再调用一次。

## 交互行为

| 操作 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 点击面板 | 光标跳到点击位置并立即改色 |
| 按住拖拽 | 节流 16ms（约 60fps）连续改色 |
| 触摸滑动 | 与鼠标拖拽一致 |
| 颜色被其他插件修改 | 监听 `change` 自动同步光标与底色 |

`updateColor` 会先取当前颜色；若为空或包含 `NaN`，会回退到红色（`alpha` 开启时为 `rgba(255,0,0,1)`）并先 `setColor`，保证面板始终有可计算的颜色。

## 事件

Panel 不定义自己的事件类型，改色时：

```ts
core.setColor(newColor)
core.trigger('change', newColor)
```

因此监听 `change` 即可拿到面板拖动产生的颜色：

```ts
picker.on('change', (color) => console.log(color))
```

## DOM 结构

```html
<div class="ew-color-picker-panel-container">
  <div class="ew-color-picker-panel ew-color-picker-panel-dynamic-size"
       style="--panel-width:285px;--panel-height:180px;background:rgba(255,0,0,1)">
    <div class="ew-color-picker-white-panel"></div>
    <div class="ew-color-picker-black-panel"></div>
    <div class="ew-color-picker-panel-cursor"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="ew-color-picker-bottom-row">
    <!-- Hue / Alpha / InputNumber / Button / ColorMode 等 -->
  </div>
</div>
```

| 类名 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `.ew-color-picker-panel` | 面板根节点 |
| `.ew-color-picker-panel-dynamic-size` | 动态尺寸标记 |
| `.ew-color-picker-white-panel` | 白色渐变层（饱和度） |
| `.ew-color-picker-black-panel` | 黑色渐变层（明度） |
| `.ew-color-picker-panel-cursor` | 拖拽光标 |
| `.ew-color-picker-bottom-row` | 底部行容器，其它插件往这里插入 |

## 完整示例

```ts
import ewColorPicker from '@ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/index.css'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/input-number.css'

const picker = new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  defaultColor: '#22c55e',
  hueDirection: 'horizontal',
  alphaDirection: 'horizontal',
  autoPanelPosition: true,
  panelPlacement: 'bottom-start',
})

// 3 秒后把光标拖到「低饱和、低明度」
setTimeout(() => {
  picker.plugins.ewColorPickerPanel.updateColor(20, 30)
}, 3000)
```

## 相关

- [Hue 色相滑块](./hue.md)
- [Alpha 透明度滑块](./alpha.md)
- [配置项 · panelPlacement](../api/options.md#panelplacement)
- [方法 · showPanel / hidePanel](../api/methods.md#showpanel)

## Predefine 预定义颜色插件

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/plugins/predefine

# Predefine 预定义颜色

`ewColorPickerPredefine` 在面板内渲染一排预设色块，点击即可快速切换到常用颜色。

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 包 | `@ew-color-picker/predefine` |
| `pluginName` | `ewColorPickerPredefine` |
| `applyOrder` | 未显式声明（按注册顺序） |
| 挂载点 | `panelContainer` |
| 访问实例 | `core.plugins.ewColorPickerPredefine` |

## 配置项

| 配置 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `predefineColor` | `(string \| { color: string; disabled?: boolean })[]` | `[]` | 预定义颜色列表；**为空时不渲染** |
| `changeColor` | `(rgba: string) => void` | — | 点击色块后的回调，参数为 `rgba()` 字符串 |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | 全局禁用后点击无效 |

### 两种数组写法

```ts
// 纯字符串
predefineColor: ['#ef4444', '#f97316', '#eab308', '#22c55e', '#3b82f6', '#a855f7']

// 带禁用项
predefineColor: [
  { color: '#ef4444' },
  { color: '#22c55e', disabled: true },
  { color: '#3b82f6' },
]
```

### 校验规则

- 使用**严格颜色格式**校验，只保留合法的 `hex` / `rgb` / `hsl` / 具名色等；
- 非法颜色会在渲染前被过滤掉；
- 点击时仍会再次校验，非法值会 `warn` 且不改色。

## 实例方法

```ts
const predefine = picker.plugins.ewColorPickerPredefine
```

| 方法 / 属性 | 签名 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `updatePredefineColors` | `(colors: string[] \| PredefineColor[]) => void` | 替换颜色列表并重新渲染、重新绑定事件 |
| `setDisabled` | `(index: number, disabled: boolean) => void` | 按索引启用/禁用单个色块 |
| `onPredefineColorClick` | `(event: Event, color: string) => void` | 点击处理逻辑（防抖 100ms） |
| `predefineItems` | `HTMLElement[]` | 色块 DOM 列表 |
| `container` | `HTMLElement \| null` | 色块容器 |

### 运行时更新

```ts
picker.plugins.ewColorPickerPredefine.updatePredefineColors([
  '#000000', '#ffffff', '#64748b',
])

picker.plugins.ewColorPickerPredefine.setDisabled(0, true)
```

## 点击行为

1. 命中色块并检查是否带 `-disabled` 类；
2. 若全局 `disabled` 为 `true`，直接阻止事件；
3. 给当前色块加 `ew-color-picker-predefine-color-active`，移除其它色块的高亮；
4. 校验颜色 → 转换为 `rgba` → 同步 `core.hsvaColor` → `core.setColor(rgba)`；
5. 调用 `options.changeColor?.(rgba)`。

## 事件

改色经由 `core.setColor()`，并会正常触发 `change`：

```ts
picker.on('change', (color) => console.log('预定义色块：', color))
```

## DOM 结构

```html
<div class="ew-color-picker-predefine-container">
  <div class="ew-color-picker-predefine-color">
    <div class="ew-color-picker-predefine-color-item" style="background:#ef4444"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="ew-color-picker-predefine-color ew-color-picker-predefine-color-disabled">…</div>
  <div class="ew-color-picker-predefine-color ew-color-picker-predefine-color-active">…</div>
</div>
```

| 类名 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `.ew-color-picker-predefine-container` | 色块容器 |
| `.ew-color-picker-predefine-color` | 单个色块外层 |
| `.ew-color-picker-predefine-color-item` | 颜色填充层 |
| `.ew-color-picker-predefine-color-disabled` | 禁用态 |
| `.ew-color-picker-predefine-color-active` | 当前选中态 |

## 完整示例

```ts
const picker = new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  defaultColor: '#3b82f6',
  predefineColor: [
    '#ef4444',
    '#f97316',
    '#eab308',
    '#22c55e',
    '#3b82f6',
    '#a855f7',
    { color: '#0f172a', disabled: true },
  ],
  changeColor: (rgba) => console.log('选中预设色：', rgba),
})
```

## 相关

- [配置项 · predefineColor](../api/options.md#predefinecolor)
- [样式与类名](../api/styles.md)

# English Docs


## Callbacks

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/api/callbacks

# Callbacks

Callbacks are functions passed through options. Unlike events, they are bound to a specific plugin or the core.

## Core callbacks

| Callback | Signature | Triggered by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `changeColor` | `(color: string) => void` | `core.setColor()` |
| `sure` | `(color: string, picker) => void` | Sure button |
| `clear` | `(picker) => void` | Clear button |
| `togglePicker` | `(isOpen: boolean) => void` | `showPanel()` / `hidePanel()` |

```ts
const picker = new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  changeColor: (color) => console.log(color),
  sure: (color, instance) => console.log(color, instance.getColor()),
  clear: (instance) => console.log('cleared', instance.getColor()),
  togglePicker: (open) => console.log(open ? 'open' : 'closed'),
})
```

::: tip Callback vs event
`changeColor` runs **inside** `setColor()` in addition to the `change` event. `sure` / `clear` are invoked by the Button plugin with arguments, while `core.emit('sure')` invokes them without arguments.
:::

## Plugin-level callbacks

### Box

| Callback | Signature | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onClick` | `(boxPlugin) => void` | After the panel toggle; blocked when `disabled` / `readonly` |
| `onMouseEnter` | `(boxPlugin) => void` | Mouse enter |
| `onMouseLeave` | `(boxPlugin) => void` | Mouse leave |

```ts
new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  onClick: (box) => console.log('box clicked', box.hasBox),
})
```

### Input

| Callback | Signature | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `changeColor` | `(rgba: string) => void` | Valid input parsed and applied |

```ts
new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  hasInput: true,
  changeColor: (rgba) => console.log('input applied', rgba),
})
```

### InputNumber

| Callback | Signature | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onChange` | `(value: number) => void` | Debounced 300ms; not called on construction |
| `onBlur` | `(value: number) => void` | Input blurred |
| `onFocus` | `(event: FocusEvent) => void` | Input focused |

```ts
import { InputNumber } from '@ew-color-picker/input-number'

new InputNumber({
  value: 50,
  min: 0,
  max: 100,
  onChange: (v) => console.log(v),
  onBlur: (v) => console.log('blur', v),
  onFocus: (e) => console.log('focus', e),
})
```

### Predefine

| Callback | Signature | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `changeColor` | `(rgba: string) => void` | Swatch clicked and applied |

### ColorMode

| Callback | Signature | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `changeMode` | `(mode, picker) => void` | After switching to `'hex' \| 'rgb' \| 'hsl'` |

```ts
new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  changeMode: (mode, instance) => console.log(mode, instance.getColor()),
})
```

### Button

| Callback | Signature | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clear` | `(picker) => void` | Clear clicked |
| `sure` | `(color, picker) => void` | Sure clicked |

## Callback vs event

| Aspect | Callback | Event |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Registration | Options object | `on()` / `once()` |
| Multiple handlers | One per option | Many |
| Removal | `updateOptions({ changeColor: noop })` | `off()` |
| Return value effect | Ignored | `true` stops propagation |
| Access to plugin instance | Usually provided | Only via payload |

Prefer events for analytics or multiple consumers; prefer callbacks for a single owner of the behavior.

## Next steps

- [Events](./events.md)
- [Options](./options.md)
- [Plugin overview](../plugins/index.md)

## Events

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/api/events

# Events

Every instance has its own event bus. The following types are registered:

```ts
['destroy', 'change', 'sure', 'clear', 'toggle', 'options-update', 'mode-change']
```

Using an unknown type logs a warning; it does not throw.

## Summary

| Event | Payload | Emitted when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | `(color: string)` | `setColor()` is called |
| `toggle` | `(isOpen: boolean)` | Panel opened/closed |
| `sure` | `(color: string, picker)` | Sure button clicked |
| `clear` | `()` | Clear button clicked |
| `options-update` | `(options)` | `updateOptions()` finished |
| `mode-change` | `(mode: 'hex' \| 'rgb' \| 'hsl')` | Color mode switched |
| `destroy` | `()` | `destroy()` finished |

## change

```ts
picker.on('change', (color) => console.log(color))
```

Emitted synchronously by `setColor()`, after `currentColor` and `hsvaColor` are updated. Every UI plugin listens to this event to stay in sync.

Calling `setColor('')` also emits `change('')` (used when clearing).

## toggle

```ts
picker.on('toggle', (isOpen) => console.log(isOpen))
```

Emitted after the open/close animation promise resolves. `pickerFlag` is already updated when listeners run.

## sure

```ts
picker.on('sure', (color, picker) => console.log(color))
```

Emitted by the Button plugin after `options.sure(color, picker)`. The panel closes afterwards.

## clear

```ts
picker.on('clear', () => console.log('cleared'))
```

Emitted by the Button plugin after `options.clear(picker)`. The panel closes afterwards.

## options-update

```ts
picker.on('options-update', (options) => console.log(options))
```

Emitted at the end of `updateOptions()`, after plugins have re-rendered.

## mode-change

```ts
picker.on('mode-change', (mode) => console.log(mode))
```

Emitted by the ColorMode plugin. `mode` is `'hex'`, `'rgb'` or `'hsl'`.

## destroy

```ts
picker.on('destroy', () => console.log('destroyed'))
```

Emitted at the very end of `destroy()`, after plugin cleanup and DOM removal.

## Listener rules

### once

```ts
picker.once('change', (color) => console.log('first change only', color))
```

### off

```ts
const handler = (color: string) => console.log(color)
picker.on('change', handler)
picker.off('change', handler)

picker.off('change') // remove all change listeners
picker.off()         // remove everything
```

### Stopping propagation

Return `true` from a listener to stop the remaining listeners of the same event:

```ts
picker.on('change', (color) => {
  if (color === '#000000') return true // stop here
})
```

### trigger vs emit

| Method | Calls listeners | Calls option callbacks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger(type, ...args)` | Yes | No |
| `emit(type, ...args)` | Yes | Yes, for `clear` / `sure` / `toggle` |

`emit('clear')` invokes `options.clear()` with no arguments; `emit('sure')` invokes `options.sure()` with no arguments; `emit('toggle', isOpen)` forwards `isOpen` to `options.togglePicker`.

## Next steps

- [Callbacks](./callbacks.md)
- [Methods](./methods.md)

## Methods

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/api/methods

# Methods

## Constructor

```ts
new ewColorPicker(options)
new ewColorPicker(el)
new ewColorPicker(el, options)
```

| Form | Example |
| --- | --- |
| Options object | `new ewColorPicker({ el: '#app', defaultColor: '#f00' })` |
| Selector + options | `new ewColorPicker('#app', { size: 'large' })` |
| Element + options | `new ewColorPicker(document.querySelector('#app')!, { size: 'large' })` |

If `el` (or the first argument) is provided, `mount()` is called automatically.

## Static methods

### use

```ts
static use(ctor: ewColorPickerPluginCtor): typeof ewColorPicker
```

Registers a plugin class. Requires `static pluginName`. Idempotent and chainable.

```ts
ewColorPicker.use(MyPlugin).use(AnotherPlugin)
```

## Mounting

### mount

```ts
mount(el?: string | HTMLElement): ewColorPicker
```

Creates `root` and `panelContainer`, then applies plugins. If `el` is omitted, uses `options.el` or `document.body`. Returns `this`.

### getMountPoint

```ts
getMountPoint(name: 'root' | 'panelContainer'): HTMLElement | undefined
```

Returns `undefined` after destruction.

### getContainer

```ts
getContainer(): HTMLElement
```

Returns the current mount container.

## Panel control

### showPanel

```ts
showPanel(animationType?: string, duration?: number): void
```

- If there is no current color, uses `defaultColor` or falls back to red and syncs plugins.
- Resolves animation, then sets `pickerFlag = true`, emits `toggle(true)`, calls `options.togglePicker(true)`, calls `syncAllPlugins`, then auto-positions the panel and binds the outside-click handler.

### hidePanel

```ts
hidePanel(animationType?: string, duration?: number): void
```

Resolves animation, resets auto-placement styles, sets `pickerFlag = false`, emits `toggle(false)`, calls `options.togglePicker(false)`, and unbinds the outside-click handler.

### openPicker / closePicker

```ts
openPicker(): void   // alias of showPanel()
closePicker(): void  // alias of hidePanel()
```

## Color

### setColor

```ts
setColor(color: string): void
```

The only supported way to change color:

1. Stores `currentColor`;
2. Converts to rgba → hsva and updates `hsvaColor` (invalid color falls back to `{h:0,s:100,v:100,a:1}`);
3. Emits `change(color)`;
4. Calls `options.changeColor(color)`.

Does nothing special for empty strings: `setColor('')` clears `currentColor` and emits `change('')`.

### getColor

```ts
getColor(): string
```

Returns `currentColor` (may be `''` when no color is selected).

### getHsvaColor / setHsvaColor

```ts
getHsvaColor(): HsvaColor           // copy
setHsvaColor(hsva: HsvaColor): void // does NOT emit change
```

`setHsvaColor` only mutates internal state; call `setColor()` afterwards if the UI must update.

## Options

### getOptions

```ts
getOptions(): ewColorPickerMergeOptionsData
```

Returns the live options object.

### updateOptions

```ts
updateOptions(newOptions: Record<string, any>): void
```

1. Merges new options;
2. If `defaultColor` is present and valid, calls `setColor(defaultColor)`; invalid values warn and keep the current color;
3. Re-applies plugins so plugin `updateOptions()` can refresh;
4. Emits `options-update(options)`.

```ts
picker.updateOptions({ size: 'small', disabled: true })
```

### syncAllPlugins

```ts
syncAllPlugins(color: string): void
```

Calls each plugin's `syncColor(color)` when it exists. Useful after external state changes.

## Events

```ts
on(type, fn, context?): this
once(type, fn, context?): this
off(type?, fn?): this | undefined
trigger(type, ...args): void
emit(type, ...args): void
```

| Method | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `on` | Add listener |
| `once` | One-shot listener |
| `off` | Remove a specific listener, all of a type, or all |
| `trigger` | Runs listeners only; returning `true` from one stops the rest |
| `emit` | Runs listeners **and** invokes `options.clear` / `options.sure` / `options.togglePicker` |

## Instance plugin use

```ts
use(plugin: ewColorPickerPlugin): ewColorPicker
```

Calls `plugin.install(this)` if present and returns `this`.

## Lifecycle

### destroy

```ts
destroy(): void
```

1. Marks the instance destroyed;
2. Unbinds the document `mousedown` listener;
3. Calls `destroy()` on every plugin instance;
4. Removes all mount points and the wrapper;
5. Clears plugin references;
6. Emits `destroy`.

Subsequent calls are no-ops.

### getDestroyedStatus

```ts
getDestroyedStatus(): boolean
```

## Instance properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `ewColorPickerMergeOptionsData` | Merged options |
| `wrapper` | `HTMLElement` | Root `.ew-color-picker` element |
| `plugins` | `Record<string, plugin>` | Plugin instances |
| `currentColor` | `string` | Current color |
| `hsvaColor` | `HsvaColor` | Current HSVA |
| `currentMode` | `'Hex' \| 'RGB' \| 'HSV'` | Core mode field |
| `pickerFlag` | `boolean` | Panel open state |
| `panelWidth` / `panelHeight` | `number` | Panel size |
| `panelLeft` / `panelTop` | `number` | Panel position |

- [Events](./events.md)
- [Callbacks](./callbacks.md)

## Options

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/api/options

# Options

Every option below can be passed to the constructor. Defaults come from `defaultConfig` in the core.

## Overview

| Group | Options |
| --- | --- |
| Core | `el`, `disabled`, `defaultColor`, `size`, `predefineColor`, `isClickOutside` |
| Layout | `hueDirection`, `alphaDirection`, `autoPanelPosition`, `panelPlacement`, `appendTo`, `prefix` |
| Labels | `clearText`, `sureText` |
| Animation | `togglePickerAnimation`, `pickerAnimationTime` |
| Plugin switches | `hasBox`, `hasPanel`, `hasInput`, `hasClear`, `hasSure`, `hue`, `alpha`, `showButton`, `showColorMode`, `showInputNumber` |
| Plugin config objects | `ewColorPickerPanel`, `ewColorPickerColorMode` |
| Box extras | `boxNoColorIcon`, `boxHasColorIcon`, `readonly`, `className`, `style` |
| Callbacks | `changeColor`, `sure`, `clear`, `togglePicker` |
| Color mode | `defaultMode`, `changeMode` |

## Core options

### el

| Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `string \| HTMLElement` | `document.body` | Mount container. A selector or element. Providing it auto-mounts. |

```ts
new ewColorPicker({ el: '#app' })
new ewColorPicker(document.getElementById('app')!)
```

### disabled

| Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `boolean` | `false` | Disables the box, panel drag, hue/alpha sliders, inputs and buttons. |

```ts
new ewColorPicker({ el: '#app', disabled: true })
```

### defaultColor

| Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `string` | `''` | Initial color; also the color restored by the Clear button. |

- With the Alpha plugin registered, a hex value is converted to `rgba()`.
- Without Alpha, a `rgba()` value is converted to hex.
- Invalid values produce a warning and keep the current color when passed to `updateOptions`.

### size

| Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `'mini' \| 'small' \| 'normal' \| 'medium' \| 'large' \| number \| { width, height } \| string` | `'normal'` | Box size |

| Preset | Size | Icon |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mini` | 20px | 12px |
| `small` | 24px | 14px |
| `normal` | 32px | 16px |
| `medium` | 36px | 18px |
| `large` | 40px | 20px |

Numbers are treated as pixels; objects accept `width`/`height`; CSS strings are used verbatim.

### predefineColor

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `predefineColor` | `(string \| { color: string; disabled?: boolean })[]` | `[]` | Predefined swatches. Empty array renders nothing. Clicking a swatch calls the top-level `changeColor` callback. |

```ts
predefineColor: ['#ef4444', '#22c55e', { color: '#0f172a', disabled: true }]
```

### isClickOutside

| Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `boolean` | `true` | Clicking outside the picker closes the panel. |

## Layout options

### hueDirection / alphaDirection

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'vertical'` |

Controls slider orientation. When both are horizontal, the panel width becomes 320px.

### autoPanelPosition

| Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `boolean` | `false` | Position the panel relative to the box automatically. Requires the Box plugin with `hasBox: true`. |

### appendTo

| Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `string \| HTMLElement` | `undefined` | Mount the panel container into an external container (e.g. `document.body`) so it is not clipped by `overflow` of dialogs or scroll containers. The panel switches to viewport-relative (`position: fixed`) placement, still follows `panelPlacement`, and re-positions on scroll or resize. |

```ts
new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#picker',
  appendTo: document.body,
  panelPlacement: 'bottom',
})
```

### prefix

| Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `string` | `'ew-'` | Prefix of every generated CSS class name. Override it when embedding the picker in another library to avoid style collisions. |

```ts
new ewColorPicker({ el: '#picker', prefix: 'my-' })
```

> The JS option must match the prefix used when compiling the styles, otherwise the class names won't line up and CSS won't apply.

When compiling the SCSS sources yourself, override `$prefix`:

```scss
@use "@ew-color-picker/style/src/index.scss" with (
  $prefix: "my-"
);
```

The prebuilt `dist/index.css` always uses the `ew-` prefix; keep the default `prefix` option when using it.

### panelPlacement

| Type | Default | Values |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `string` | `'bottom'` | `top-start` `top` `top-end` `left-start` `left` `left-end` `right-start` `right` `right-end` `bottom-start` `bottom` `bottom-end` |

Gap is 5px; out-of-viewport positions are adjusted automatically.

## Labels

| Option | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clearText` | `string` | `'清空'` |
| `sureText` | `string` | `'确定'` |

Change them for i18n:

```ts
new ewColorPicker({ clearText: 'Reset', sureText: 'Apply' })
```

## Animation

### togglePickerAnimation

| Type | Default | Values |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `string` | `'default'` | `'default'`, `'height'`, `'opacity'` |

Only `height` and `opacity` are animated; `default` toggles instantly.

### pickerAnimationTime

| Type | Default | Range |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `number` | `200` | 0–10000 (ms) |

Values above 10000 are clamped.

## Plugin switches

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hasBox` | `boolean` | `true` | Hide the trigger swatch |
| `hasPanel` | `boolean` | `true` | Hide the 2D panel |
| `hasInput` | `boolean` | `true` | Hide the text input |
| `hasClear` | `boolean` | `true` | Hide the Clear button |
| `hasSure` | `boolean` | `true` | Hide the Sure button |
| `hue` | `boolean` | `true` | Hide the hue slider |
| `alpha` | `boolean` | `true` | Hide the alpha slider |
| `showButton` | `boolean` | `true` | Hide clear + sure buttons at once |
| `showColorMode` | `boolean` | `true` | Hide the Hex/RGB/HSL switcher |
| `showInputNumber` | `boolean` | `true` | Skip the InputNumber plugin's own numeric input; ColorMode channel inputs are unaffected |

```ts
new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  hasPanel: false,
  hue: false,
  alpha: false,
  hasInput: false,
  hasClear: false,
  hasSure: false,
})
```

## Plugin config objects

| Option | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ewColorPickerPanel` | `boolean` | `false` disables the panel (same as `hasPanel: false`) |
| `ewColorPickerColorMode` | `boolean \| object` | `false` disables mode switching; object merges color-mode options |

## Box extras

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `boxNoColorIcon` | `string` | `''` | Custom HTML for the "no color" icon |
| `boxHasColorIcon` | `string` | `''` | Custom HTML for the "has color" icon |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Prevents clicking the box |
| `className` | `string` | `''` | Extra class on `.ew-color-picker-box` |
| `style` | `string \| Record<string,string>` | `''` | Inline styles for the box |

## Color mode

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultMode` | `'hex' \| 'rgb' \| 'hsl'` | `'rgb'` with Alpha, otherwise `'hex'` | Initial mode |
| `changeMode` | `(mode, picker) => void` | — | Mode change callback |

## Callbacks

| Callback | Signature | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `changeColor` | `(color: string) => void` | Color changed |
| `sure` | `(color: string, picker) => void` | Sure button clicked |
| `clear` | `(picker) => void` | Clear button clicked |
| `togglePicker` | `(isOpen: boolean) => void` | Panel toggled |

## Complete example

```ts
const picker = new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  defaultColor: 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.8)',
  size: 'large',
  predefineColor: ['#ef4444', '#22c55e', '#3b82f6', { color: '#0f172a', disabled: true }],
  hueDirection: 'horizontal',
  alphaDirection: 'horizontal',
  clearText: 'Reset',
  sureText: 'Apply',
  togglePickerAnimation: 'height',
  pickerAnimationTime: 250,
  autoPanelPosition: true,
  panelPlacement: 'bottom-start',
  defaultMode: 'rgb',
  changeColor: (color) => console.log(color),
  sure: (color) => console.log('sure', color),
})
```

## Styles & Classes

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/api/styles

# Styles & Classes

## Stylesheet entries

| File | Required | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@ew-color-picker/style/dist/index.css` | Yes | Picker, box, panel, sliders, buttons, mode switcher, predefine |
| `@ew-color-picker/style/dist/input-number.css` | Yes for numeric inputs | InputNumber component |

```ts
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/index.css'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/input-number.css'
```

::: warning
Importing only `index.css` leaves RGB/HSL numeric inputs unstyled.
:::

## Class prefix

All class names start with `ew-` by default (e.g. `.ew-color-picker-box`, `.ew-input-number`). Change the JS-side prefix with the [`prefix`](./options#prefix) constructor option and mirror it in the stylesheet through the SCSS `$prefix` variable:

```scss
@use "@ew-color-picker/style/src/index.scss" with ($prefix: "my-");
@use "@ew-color-picker/style/src/input-number.scss" with ($prefix: "my-");
```

The prebuilt `dist/*.css` files always use the `ew-` prefix; keep the default `prefix` option when using them.

## CSS variables

| Variable | Set on | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--panel-width` | `.ew-color-picker-panel` | computed (285/302/320px) | Panel width |
| `--panel-height` | `.ew-color-picker-panel` | `180px` | Panel height |

Override them after importing the styles:

```css
.ew-color-picker .ew-color-picker-panel {
  --panel-width: 320px;
  --panel-height: 200px;
}
```

## Theming example

```css
/* Brand buttons */
.ew-color-picker-sure-btn {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1, #8b5cf6);
  border: none;
  color: #fff;
}

/* Rounded trigger */
.ew-color-picker-box {
  border-radius: 12px;
}

/* Bigger panel */
.ew-color-picker-panel {
  --panel-width: 340px;
  --panel-height: 200px;
}
```

## Multi-instance isolation

Class names are global. If you need per-instance styling, pass a `className` (Box) or scope styles to a wrapper:

```html
<div class="theme-dark">
  <div id="picker"></div>
</div>
```

```css
.theme-dark .ew-color-picker-panel {
  background: #111827;
}
```

## Examples

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/examples/

# Examples

Twelve minimal recipes. Runnable HTML files live in the repository's `examples/` directory.

## 1. Basic

```html
<div id="app"></div>
<script src="@ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker/dist/index.min.js"></script>
<script>
  const picker = new ewColorPicker({ el: '#app', defaultColor: '#3b82f6' })
  picker.on('change', (color) => console.log(color))
</script>
```

## 2. Layout & orientation

```ts
new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  hueDirection: 'horizontal',
  alphaDirection: 'horizontal',
  size: 'large',
})
```

## 3. Predefined colors

```ts
new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  predefineColor: ['#ef4444', '#22c55e', '#3b82f6', { color: '#0f172a', disabled: true }],
})
```

## 4. Buttons

```ts
new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  hasClear: false,
  sureText: 'Apply color',
  sure: (color) => console.log(color),
})
```

## 5. Events & callbacks

```ts
const picker = new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  changeColor: (color) => console.log('callback', color),
})

picker.once('change', (color) => console.log('once', color))
picker.on('sure', (color) => console.log('sure', color))
picker.on('clear', () => console.log('clear'))
picker.on('toggle', (open) => console.log(open))
```

## 6. Auto panel placement

```ts
new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  autoPanelPosition: true,
  panelPlacement: 'top-end',
})
```

## 7. Toggle animation

```ts
new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  togglePickerAnimation: 'height',
  pickerAnimationTime: 300,
})
```

Available: `default`, `height`, `opacity`. Maximum duration is 10000ms.

## 8. Disabled & readonly

```ts
new ewColorPicker({ el: '#app', disabled: true })
new ewColorPicker({ el: '#app', readonly: true, defaultColor: '#84cc16' })
```

## 9. Color modes

```ts
new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  defaultMode: 'rgb',
  showColorMode: true,
  changeMode: (mode) => console.log(mode),
})
```

## 10. Instance API

```ts
const picker = new ewColorPicker({ el: '#app', defaultColor: '#f43f5e' })

console.log(picker.getColor())
console.log(picker.getHsvaColor())
picker.setColor('#22c55e')
picker.updateOptions({ size: 'large' })
picker.showPanel()
picker.hidePanel()
picker.destroy()
```

## 11. Numeric input

```ts
import { InputNumber } from '@ew-color-picker/input-number'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/input-number.css'

const num = new InputNumber({ value: 50, min: 0, max: 100, onChange: console.log })
document.body.appendChild(num.getElement())
```

## 12. Multiple instances

```ts
[...document.querySelectorAll('.picker')].forEach((el) => {
  new ewColorPicker({ el, defaultColor: '#a855f7' })
})
```

::: warning No NodeList
The constructor does not accept a NodeList or array. Instantiate one by one. Events, mount points and inputs are isolated per instance.
:::

## Changelog

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/guide/changelog

# Changelog

## 2.0.1

> These changes are merged into the main branch and reflected in the docs site. The npm packages are not published yet and will be released together with further fixes.

### Fixes

- Fixed plugin switches being overridden: `ewColorPickerPanel: false` and `ewColorPickerColorMode: false` (or an object config) were replaced by defaults and did not take effect
- Panel container now declares `box-sizing: content-box`, no longer relying on the host global `box-sizing` reset
- Removed viewport media queries (`max-width: 768px`) that hard-coded panel, input and preset sizes; inner sizes are now driven solely by `--panel-width` / `--panel-height`
- Predefined swatches now use flex wrapping; removed the hard-coded "10 per row" rule that caused wrong wrapping when the swatch count or container width changed
- `use()` now deduplicates by `pluginName`, preventing duplicate registration under HMR, repeated imports or multiple entry points
- Plugin constructor errors are now reported through `console.warn` with the plugin name and error details instead of being silently swallowed, making custom plugin debugging easier

### Features

- New `appendTo` option: mount the panel container into `document.body` or any container to avoid `overflow` clipping by dialogs, drawers and scroll containers. The panel then uses viewport-relative positioning, still honors `panelPlacement` with boundary flipping, and re-positions on scroll or resize
- New `prefix` option: customize the prefix of every CSS class name (default `ew-`) to avoid style collisions when embedding the picker in another library. The SCSS build exposes a matching `$prefix` variable that must stay in sync with the JS option

### Documentation

- Corrected predefined swatch and number input class names to match the source
- Removed the non-existent nested `ewColorPickerBox` config in favor of top-level options
- Corrected the prerequisites of `autoPanelPosition`
- Added `appendTo` documentation (Chinese and English)
- Added `prefix` documentation (Chinese and English) with a custom SCSS build example

## 2.0.0

First stable release: core + plugin architecture, 14 packages (13 scoped packages plus the unscoped `ew-color-picker` entry package), bilingual docs site and live demo.

## Comparison & Positioning

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/guide/comparison

# Comparison & Positioning

Choosing a color picker is rarely about feature count — it is about whether the component fits your UI system. This page states the positioning first, then compares the mainstream options, and finally explains when each one is the right call.

## Positioning in one sentence

ew-color-picker is not a ready-made skin. It is an **assemblable color picker foundation**: the core only keeps color state and events, and every UI element is an independent plugin. Teams keep what they need, replace what they do not, or write their own UI on the same plugin contract.

Good fit: admin dashboards, low-code platforms, component libraries, and products that must merge deeply with an existing design system.
Poor fit: a one-off color input where customization is unnecessary — the native `input[type=color]` or Coloris is simpler.

## Side-by-side comparison

The numbers below come from the npm registry (`unpackedSize` and last publish date, collected on 2026-10-30) and are only a sense of package size. Feature columns follow each project's public documentation.

| Option | Shape | Framework lock-in | Extension model | Unpacked size | Last publish |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **ew-color-picker** | Aggregate package + 13 plugin packages (plus the `ew-color-picker` compat entry) | None (plain DOM) | Plugin registration / custom plugins | Aggregate 84.6 KB + styles 36.1 KB (120.7 KB total); `core.min` 11.9 KB (gzip 3.9 KB) | 2026-10 |
| [Pickr](https://github.com/Simonwep/pickr) | Single package (UMD/ESM) | None | Themes (classic/monolith/nano) + options | 280.3 KB | 2026-09 |
| [iro.js](https://github.com/jaames/iro.js) | Single package | None | Options + component composition | 231.4 KB | 2021-07 |
| [Coloris](https://github.com/melloware/coloris) | Single package + CSS | None | CSS variables + options | 152.2 KB | 2026-10 |
| [react-colorful](https://github.com/omgovich/react-colorful) | React components | React | Compose components | 398.4 KB | 2026-09 |
| [react-color](https://github.com/casesandberg/react-color) | React component set | React | Pick a picker component | 436.3 KB | 2020-10 |
| [vue-color](https://github.com/linx4200/vue-color) | Vue component set | Vue | Pick a picker component | 391.5 KB | 2025-10 |
| [@uiw/react-color](https://github.com/uiwjs/react-color) | React component set | React | Import per component | 210.8 KB | 2026-05 |
| Native `input[type=color]` | Built into browsers | None | None (styling is not controllable) | 0 | with browser updates |
| Spectrum | jQuery plugin | jQuery | Options | 1804.2 KB | 2020-05 |

One caveat: unpacked size is not runtime cost. The aggregate package ships two artifacts (UMD.min and ESM) plus `.d.ts` declarations. The smallest runtime you can ship is `index.min.js` at **81.8 KB (gzip 19.4 KB)**, or **11.9 KB (gzip 3.9 KB)** when using the core alone. Add the two style sheets (about 3.7 KB gzipped) for the full out-of-the-box footprint — roughly 29 KB of tarballs in total.

## Where ew-color-picker stands out

### 1. Structural replaceability, not just theming

Most alternatives let you restyle the widget via themes, CSS variables or options while the structure stays fixed. ew-color-picker splits the trigger box, saturation panel, hue slider, alpha slider, text input, number input, buttons, predefined swatches and mode switcher into separate plugins. You decide which ones are registered, in what order, and whether your own plugin replaces them.

```ts
import ewColorPicker from '@ew-color-picker/core'
import Panel from '@ew-color-picker/panel'
import Hue from '@ew-color-picker/hue'
// register only what you need
ewColorPicker.use(Panel).use(Hue)
```

### 2. Framework agnostic

The core touches plain DOM and events only — no React, Vue or jQuery runtime. The same plugin contract can back React, Vue, Angular or low-code wrappers without maintaining a separate implementation per framework.

### 3. Single source of truth with per-instance events

Every plugin changes color through `core.setColor()`, and the `change` event keeps the rest in sync, so there is never a second copy of the color state. Each instance owns its event bus, DOM and plugin instances, so multi-instance pages do not leak into each other.

### 4. Complete out of the box

The aggregate package (or the `ew-color-picker` compat entry) ships Hex / RGB / HSL mode switching, alpha adjustment, predefined swatches, clear/confirm buttons and input validation — things you would otherwise assemble by hand on top of react-colorful.

### 5. TypeScript types everywhere

Every package emits `.d.ts`; plugins extend the core options via `declare module`, so custom plugins keep type inference too.

### 6. Documentation as part of the product

Bilingual documentation, per-API references, one page per plugin, plus `llms.txt` / `llms-full.txt` so both people and AI can look things up.

## Limitations to be honest about

- **Small ecosystem**: download counts, community tutorials and issue history cannot match Pickr or react-color; unusual problems mean reading the source.
- **No official framework wrappers**: React / Vue / Angular / Solid integration is covered in [Framework Integration](./framework-integration); controlled components and SSR need a thin wrapper of your own (around 20 lines).
- **No gradients, multi-color editing or eyedropper**: those use cases need iro.js or a dedicated gradient picker.
- **The plugin model only matters when you customize**: installing the aggregate package or `npm i ew-color-picker` works out of the box; you only need to understand core + plugins when replacing part of the UI or wiring your own plugins.
- **Shrinking further means installing sub-packages**: the aggregate is 84.6 KB plus 36.1 KB of styles, already in Coloris territory; if you use a single piece, install plugin packages and trim down to the 11.9 KB core.

## Choosing the right tool

| Your situation | Recommendation |
| --- | --- |
| A plain color input; styling does not matter | Native `input[type=color]` |
| Lightweight, dependency-free, themeable without structural changes | Coloris or Pickr |
| React project that only needs a panel or slider | react-colorful |
| Vue project that wants ready-made components | vue-color or @uiw/react-color |
| Gradients, color-space work, games or visualizations | iro.js |
| Admin / low-code / component library needing deep design-system integration, partial UI replacement and instance isolation | **ew-color-picker** |
| Embedding color selection into your own plugin system or runtime | **ew-color-picker** (11.9 KB core, keep the core and write your own plugins) |

## See also

- [Introduction](./) — design principles and package layout
- [Core Concepts](./concepts) — mount points, plugin order and events
- [Writing a Plugin](./plugin-dev) — replace the built-in UI with your own

## Core Concepts

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/guide/concepts

# Core Concepts

## Instance-level event bus

Every instance extends `EventEmitter` and registers exactly these event types:

```ts
['destroy', 'change', 'sure', 'clear', 'toggle', 'options-update', 'mode-change']
```

`on` / `once` / `off` / `trigger` / `emit` are available on the instance. Unknown event names log a warning instead of throwing.

| Method | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `on(type, fn)` | Add a listener |
| `once(type, fn)` | Add a one-shot listener |
| `off(type?, fn?)` | Remove one listener, all listeners of a type, or everything |
| `trigger(type, ...args)` | Run listeners directly; `return true` from a listener stops the rest |
| `emit(type, ...args)` | Like `trigger`, but also invokes the matching `options` callback (`clear`, `sure`, `togglePicker`) |

## Mount points

When mounting, the core creates:

```html
<div class="ew-color-picker" data-uid="…">
  <div class="ew-color-picker-panel-container ew-color-picker-panel-container-hidden">
    …
  </div>
</div>
```

| Mount point | Access | Used by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `root` | `core.getMountPoint('root')` | Box |
| `panelContainer` | `core.getMountPoint('panelContainer')` | Panel, Hue, Alpha, Input, InputNumber, Button, Predefine, ColorMode |

The panel container is hidden with the `-hidden` class and revealed when the panel opens.

## Plugin apply order

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `ApplyOrder.Pre` (`-1`) | Runs before the core's default logic |
| `ApplyOrder.Post` (`1`) | Runs after the core's default logic |
| not set | Runs in registration order |

All built-in UI plugins use `Post`.

## Single color entry

`core.setColor(color)` is the only supported way to change color. It:

1. Normalises the color (hex ↔ rgba depending on the Alpha plugin);
2. Updates `currentColor` and `hsvaColor`;
3. Emits `change`;
4. Calls `options.changeColor(color)`.

Plugins must subscribe to `change` instead of polling `currentColor`.

## Plugin registry

```ts
ewColorPicker.plugins        // array of registered { name, applyOrder, ctor }
ewColorPicker.pluginsMap     // { [pluginName]: true }
core.plugins                 // instance map: { [pluginName]: instance }
```

`core.plugins.ewColorPickerPanel`, `core.plugins.ewColorPickerAlpha`, etc. expose each plugin instance.

## Instance isolation

Each instance gets:

- its own event bus,
- its own `data-uid`,
- its own DOM subtree,
- its own plugin instances.

That is why multiple instances never share colors. Always scope DOM queries to the current wrapper.

## Lifecycle

```text
new ewColorPicker(options)
  → normalize options
  → init state (currentColor, hsvaColor, mode)
  → mount(el) if el provided
      → create root + panelContainer
      → apply plugins (Pre → default → Post)
      → sync hue/alpha

picker.destroy()
  → emit destroy
  → plugin.destroy()
  → remove DOM and listeners
  → mark instance as destroyed
```

## Next steps

- [Write a plugin](./plugin-dev.md)
- [Events](../api/events.md)
- [Methods](../api/methods.md)

## Framework Integration

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/guide/framework-integration

# Framework Integration

ew-color-picker depends only on plain DOM and events — no framework runtime — so the same approach works everywhere: **create the instance on mount, call `destroy()` on unmount, and sync controlled values through `setColor()`**.

Below are minimal, copy-paste wrappers for four frameworks. No official framework packages are published; the reasoning is covered in [Comparison & Positioning](./comparison).

## Common rules

1. **One instance per mount point**: `el` accepts either a selector string or a DOM element; prefer the element reference so multiple pickers never collide on selectors.
2. **Always call `destroy()` on unmount**: the instance registers a `document` click listener. Leaking it breaks other instances by toggling their panels.
3. **Guard controlled sync against loops**: call `setColor()` when the external value changes, but `setColor()` fires `change` again — compare the incoming value first.
4. **Import both stylesheets**: `index.css` and `input-number.css` (the number input styles ship in a separate file).
5. **SSR safety**: create the instance only in browser-side lifecycle hooks (`useEffect` / `onMounted` / `ngAfterViewInit` / `onMount`).

```ts
import ewColorPicker from '@ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/index.css'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/input-number.css'
```

## React

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import ewColorPicker from '@ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/index.css'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/input-number.css'

interface Props {
  value: string
  onChange: (color: string) => void
}

export function ColorField({ value, onChange }: Props) {
  const hostRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const pickerRef = useRef<ewColorPicker | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    const picker = new ewColorPicker({
      el: hostRef.current!,
      defaultColor: value,
    })
    picker.on('change', (color: string) => onChange(color))
    pickerRef.current = picker

    return () => {
      picker.destroy()
      pickerRef.current = null
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    pickerRef.current?.setColor(value)
  }, [value])

  return <div ref={hostRef} />
}
```

React 19 StrictMode mounts effects twice; the `return () => picker.destroy()` cleanup above prevents leftover instances.

## Vue 3

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import ewColorPicker from '@ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/index.css'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/input-number.css'

const props = defineProps<{ modelValue: string }>()
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [string] }>()

const hostRef = ref<HTMLDivElement>()
let picker: ewColorPicker | null = null

onMounted(() => {
  picker = new ewColorPicker({
    el: hostRef.value!,
    defaultColor: props.modelValue,
    changeColor: (color: string) => emit('update:modelValue', color),
  })
})

watch(
  () => props.modelValue,
  (value) => {
    if (picker && picker.getColor() !== value) picker.setColor(value)
  },
)

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  picker?.destroy()
  picker = null
})
</script>

<template>
  <div ref="hostRef" />
</template>
```

Usage is the standard `v-model`:

```vue
<ColorField v-model="color" />
```

## Angular

```ts
import {
  AfterViewInit,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  OnDestroy,
  Output,
  ViewChild,
} from '@angular/core'
import ewColorPicker from '@ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker'

@Component({
  selector: 'ew-color-field',
  standalone: true,
  template: '<div #host></div>',
})
export class ColorFieldComponent implements AfterViewInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('host', { static: true }) host!: ElementRef<HTMLDivElement>
  @Input() value = '#ffffff'
  @Output() valueChange = new EventEmitter<string>()

  private picker?: ewColorPicker

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    this.picker = new ewColorPicker({
      el: this.host.nativeElement,
      defaultColor: this.value,
      changeColor: (color: string) => this.valueChange.emit(color),
    })
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.picker?.destroy()
  }
}
```

Use it with two-way binding:

```html
<ew-color-field [(value)]="color" />
```

## Solid

```tsx
import { onCleanup, onMount } from 'solid-js'
import ewColorPicker from '@ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/index.css'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/input-number.css'

export function ColorField(props: { value: string; onChange: (color: string) => void }) {
  let host!: HTMLDivElement
  let picker: ewColorPicker | undefined

  onMount(() => {
    picker = new ewColorPicker({ el: host, defaultColor: props.value })
    picker.on('change', (color: string) => props.onChange(color))
  })

  onCleanup(() => picker?.destroy())

  return <div ref={host} />
}
```

Solid's fine-grained reactivity needs no extra plumbing: call `setColor()` inside a `createEffect` that reads `props.value`.

## FAQ

**Can I pass a selector string?**
Yes, `el: '#picker'` works. Inside a framework, prefer the element reference so duplicate ids cannot clash.

**Why did another picker close my panel?**
An instance was not destroyed on unmount, so its leftover `document` click listener toggles panels everywhere.

**Does the `change` event loop forever?**
Only when you write the value back to the component and the component writes it back with `setColor()`. Compare old and new values to break the loop.

**Do I need official wrapper packages?**
The code above is the complete wrapper. If a project uses it in several places, extract these twenty lines into your own component rather than depending on a third-party package.

## Quick Start

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/guide/getting-started

# Quick Start

## 1. Prepare a container

```html
<div id="picker"></div>
```

```ts
import ewColorPicker from '@ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/index.css'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/input-number.css'
```

## 2. Create an instance

There are three equivalent ways to pass the container:

```ts
// Selector
new ewColorPicker({ el: '#picker', defaultColor: '#6366f1' })

// DOM element
const el = document.getElementById('picker')!
new ewColorPicker(el, { defaultColor: '#6366f1' })

// Element in options object (same as the first form)
new ewColorPicker({ el, defaultColor: '#6366f1' })
```

If `el` is provided, the picker **mounts automatically**. Without `el`, call `mount()` yourself later.

## 3. Listen for changes

```ts
const picker = new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#picker',
  defaultColor: '#6366f1',
})

picker.on('change', (color) => {
  console.log('Current color:', color)
})

picker.on('sure', (color) => {
  console.log('Confirmed:', color)
})
```

## 4. A fuller example

```ts
const picker = new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#picker',
  defaultColor: '#6366f1',
  size: 'large',
  hueDirection: 'horizontal',
  alphaDirection: 'horizontal',
  predefineColor: ['#ef4444', '#22c55e', '#3b82f6', '#a855f7'],
  clearText: 'Reset',
  sureText: 'Apply',
  autoPanelPosition: true,
  panelPlacement: 'bottom-start',
  togglePickerAnimation: 'height',
  pickerAnimationTime: 250,
})

picker.on('change', (color) => console.log('change', color))
picker.on('toggle', (open) => console.log('panel', open ? 'open' : 'closed'))
picker.on('mode-change', (mode) => console.log('mode', mode))
```

## 5. Methods

```ts
picker.getColor()          // current color string
picker.getHsvaColor()      // { h, s, v, a }
picker.setColor('#22c55e') // programmatic change (emits change)
picker.showPanel()
picker.hidePanel()
picker.updateOptions({ size: 'small' })
```

Full reference: [Methods](../api/methods.md).

## 6. Cleanup

```ts
picker.destroy()
```

`destroy()` removes DOM, unbinds DOM events, clears listeners, and emits `destroy`. After destruction, most methods become no-ops; check `picker.getDestroyedStatus()`.

- [Options](../api/options.md)
- [Plugin overview](../plugins/index.md)

## Introduction

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/guide/

# Introduction

ew-color-picker is a modern color picker built around two ideas:

1. **Event-driven** — every action becomes an event (`change`, `sure`, `clear`, `toggle`, `mode-change`, `options-update`, `destroy`).
2. **Plugin-based** — the core owns color state and mount points; every piece of UI is a plugin.

```text
Core (@ew-color-picker/core)
├─ color state: currentColor + hsvaColor
├─ event bus: on / once / off / trigger / emit
├─ mount points: root + panelContainer
└─ plugins: can be registered, replaced, or extended
```

## Why a plugin architecture?

| Benefit | What it means |
| --- | --- |
| Small bundles | Install only the plugins you use |
| Replaceable UI | Swap the panel, input, or buttons for your own implementation |
| Testable | Each plugin can be tested in isolation |
| Extensible | Add features without touching the core |

## The 14 packages

| Package | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `@ew-color-picker/core` | Color state, event bus, mount points, plugin registry |
| `@ew-color-picker/utils` | DOM/color/animation helpers, `EventEmitter`, `Console` plugin |
| `@ew-color-picker/style` | CSS (`index.css` + `input-number.css`) |
| `@ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker` | All-in-one bundle: registers all plugins and re-exports the core |
| `ew-color-picker` | Unscoped compat entry for v1 users; forwards the aggregate package and styles |
| `@ew-color-picker/box` | Trigger swatch that opens/closes the panel |
| `@ew-color-picker/panel` | Saturation/value 2D panel |
| `@ew-color-picker/hue` | Hue slider (0–360°) |
| `@ew-color-picker/alpha` | Alpha slider (0–1) |
| `@ew-color-picker/input` | Text color input with validation |
| `@ew-color-picker/input-number` | Numeric input component + plugin |
| `@ew-color-picker/button` | Clear / Sure buttons |
| `@ew-color-picker/predefine` | Predefined color swatches |
| `@ew-color-picker/color-mode` | Hex / RGB / HSL mode switching |

## Data flow

```text
User interaction (Box / Panel / Hue / Alpha / Input / Predefine / Button)
        │
        ▼
   core.setColor(color)        ← the only way to change color
        │
        ├─► emit('change', color)
        │     ├─ Panel   sync background + cursor
        │     ├─ Hue     sync thumb
        │     ├─ Alpha   sync thumb
        │     ├─ Input   sync text
        │     ├─ ColorMode sync R/G/B or H/S/L inputs
        │     └─ Box     sync background + icon color
        │
        └─► options.changeColor(color)
```

## Design principles

| Principle | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Single source of truth | Only `core.setColor()` changes color; plugins never call each other directly |
| Instance isolation | Each instance has its own event bus, DOM and plugin instances |
| No global pollution | CSS is scoped by class names; the only global is the UMD `window.ewColorPicker` |
| Progressive disclosure | Defaults work out of the box; every plugin exposes options and methods when you need them |

## Next steps

- [Installation](./installation.md)
- [Quick start](./getting-started.md)
- [Core concepts](./concepts.md)
- [Write a plugin](./plugin-dev.md)

## Installation

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/guide/installation

# Installation

## Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Node.js | 20.10+ (for building and running the docs) |
| Package manager | pnpm (workspace) / npm / yarn |
| Browser | Any modern browser (ES2019+) |

## All-in-one bundle

```bash
pnpm add @ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker @ew-color-picker/style
```

```ts
import ewColorPicker from '@ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/index.css'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/input-number.css'

const picker = new ewColorPicker({ el: '#app' })
```

::: warning Two stylesheets
`index.css` covers the picker. `input-number.css` is required for the numeric inputs used by RGB/HSL modes. Import both.
:::

To keep the v1 package name, install the unscoped entry package instead — it is equivalent:

```bash
npm install ew-color-picker
```

::: tip About the package name
`ew-color-picker` is a thin compatibility entry for v2. It only forwards to `@ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker` and `@ew-color-picker/style`; it contains no implementation code.
:::

## Upgrading from v1

v2 is a breaking rewrite; v1 and v2 APIs cannot be mixed:

- **Architecture**: v1 was a single configurable package; v2 splits into 13 packages plus a compat entry where every UI part is a plugin, composable via `Core.use(Plugin)`
- **Package name**: `ew-color-picker` remains the entry, but now points to `@ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker`
- **Styles**: both `index.css` and `input-number.css` must be imported explicitly
- **Options and events**: plugin options such as `hasAlpha` and `hasBox` differ from v1; re-integrate against the live demo on this site

To stay on the old version, pin `ew-color-picker@1`; the v1 source is preserved on the `v1` branch.

## Per-package imports

The core has no UI. Register only what you need:

```bash
pnpm add @ew-color-picker/core @ew-color-picker/style \
  @ew-color-picker/box @ew-color-picker/panel @ew-color-picker/hue \
  @ew-color-picker/input @ew-color-picker/button
```

```ts
import ewColorPicker from '@ew-color-picker/core'
import Box from '@ew-color-picker/box'
import Panel from '@ew-color-picker/panel'
import Hue from '@ew-color-picker/hue'
import Input from '@ew-color-picker/input'
import Button from '@ew-color-picker/button'

ewColorPicker.use(Box).use(Panel).use(Hue).use(Input).use(Button)

new ewColorPicker({ el: '#app' })
```

`use()` returns the class itself, so calls can be chained. It is idempotent — registering the same constructor twice does nothing.

## UMD via `<script>`

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/@ew-color-picker/style/dist/index.css" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/@ew-color-picker/style/dist/input-number.css" />

<div id="app"></div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/@ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker/dist/index.min.js"></script>
<script>
  const picker = new ewColorPicker({ el: '#app', defaultColor: '#3b82f6' })
</script>
```

The UMD build exposes `window.ewColorPicker`.

## TypeScript

All packages ship declaration files. Types are exported from the core and from each plugin package:

```ts
import type { ewColorPickerOptions, ewColorPickerConstructorOptions } from '@ew-color-picker/core'
import type { InputNumberOptions } from '@ew-color-picker/input-number'

const options: ewColorPickerConstructorOptions = {
  el: '#app',
  defaultColor: '#6366f1',
}
```

## Repository development

```bash
pnpm install        # install workspace dependencies
pnpm run build:all  # build every package + styles
pnpm run dev:preview# live-reload example server
pnpm run test:run   # run the full vitest suite
pnpm run docs:dev   # start the documentation site
```

## Writing a Plugin

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/guide/plugin-dev

# Writing a Plugin

A plugin is a plain class. The core only requires two static properties and a constructor.

## Minimal template

```ts
import type ewColorPicker from '@ew-color-picker/core'
import { ApplyOrder, create, addClass, insertNode, isFunction } from '@ew-color-picker/utils'

export default class MyBadgePlugin {
  static pluginName = 'myBadge'
  static applyOrder = ApplyOrder.Post

  el: HTMLElement | null = null

  constructor(public ewColorPicker: ewColorPicker) {
    this.run()

    if (isFunction(this.ewColorPicker.on)) {
      this.ewColorPicker.on('change', this.handleChange)
    }
  }

  run() {
    const panelContainer = this.ewColorPicker.getMountPoint('panelContainer')
    if (!panelContainer) return

    this.el = create('span')
    addClass(this.el, 'my-badge')
    insertNode(panelContainer, this.el)
    this.renderColor(this.ewColorPicker.getColor())
  }

  handleChange = (color: string) => {
    this.renderColor(color)
  }

  renderColor(color?: string) {
    if (this.el) this.el.textContent = color || 'no color'
  }

  destroy() {
    if (isFunction(this.ewColorPicker.off)) {
      this.ewColorPicker.off('change', this.handleChange)
    }
    this.el?.parentNode?.removeChild(this.el)
    this.el = null
  }
}
```

## Register it

```ts
import ewColorPicker from '@ew-color-picker/core'
import MyBadgePlugin from './my-badge'

ewColorPicker.use(MyBadgePlugin)

new ewColorPicker({ el: '#app' })
```

`use()` is chainable and idempotent.

## Contract

| Member | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `static pluginName` | Yes | Unique key in `core.plugins`; missing name logs a warning |
| `static applyOrder` | No | `ApplyOrder.Pre` / `Post` / `undefined` |
| `constructor(core)` | Yes | Receives the instance; render + subscribe here |
| `destroy()` | No | Unbind DOM events and listeners |
| `install(core)` | No | Support manual `plugin.install(core)` usage |
| `updateOptions()` | No | Called when `core.updateOptions()` broadcasts `options-update` |

## Rules

1. Change colors only via `core.setColor()`.
2. Subscribe to `change` rather than reading state in loops.
3. Render only into `root` or `panelContainer`.
4. Scope DOM queries to your own wrapper.
5. Clean up everything in `destroy()`.

## Type augmentation

Declare your options on the core's `CustomOptions` interface:

```ts
declare module '@ew-color-picker/core' {
  interface CustomOptions {
    myBadge?: {
      label?: string
    }
  }
}
```

Now `new ewColorPicker({ myBadge: { label: 'Hi' } })` type-checks.

## Lifecycle summary

```text
Core.use(Plugin)  → registered statically
new ewColorPicker → creates instance, calls constructor
mount(el)         → mount points exist, plugins render
updateOptions()   → updateOptions() + options-update event
destroy()         → destroy() called, DOM removed
```

## Next steps

- [Plugin overview](../plugins/index.md)
- [Core concepts](./concepts.md)
