```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="@ew-color-picker/style/dist/index.css" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="@ew-color-picker/style/dist/input-number.css" />

<div id="picker"></div>

<script type="module">
  import ewColorPicker from '@ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker'

  const picker = new ewColorPicker({
    el: '#picker',
    defaultColor: '#6366f1',
    predefineColor: ['#6366f1', '#8b5cf6', '#06b6d4', '#22c55e'],
    changeColor(color) {
      console.log('Current color:', color)
    }
  })
</script>
```

## Alpha Plugin

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/alpha

# Alpha

`ewColorPickerAlpha` adds an alpha slider (0–1). Registering it changes how the core normalizes colors:

- **Registered**: hex `defaultColor` becomes `rgba()`
- **Not registered**: `rgba()` `defaultColor` becomes hex

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package | `@ew-color-picker/alpha` |
| `pluginName` | `ewColorPickerAlpha` |
| `applyOrder` | `Post` |
| Mount point | `panelContainer` |
| Instance | `core.plugins.ewColorPickerAlpha` |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alpha` | `boolean` | `true` | `false` hides the slider |
| `alphaDirection` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'vertical'` | Orientation |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Blocks interaction |

## Methods

| Method / property | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enableAlpha` | `(enable = true) => void` | Show/hide |
| `updateAlpha` | `(alpha: number) => void` | Apply alpha (0–1) via `setColor()` |
| `updateAlphaThumbPosition` | `(alpha: number) => void` | Move thumb only |
| `hasAlpha` | `boolean` getter/setter | Re-renders on change |
| `alphaBar` / `alphaThumb` | `HTMLElement \| null` | DOM |
| `isHorizontal` | `boolean` | Orientation flag |

`updateAlpha` also syncs ColorMode inputs when the current mode is not `hex`.

## Behaviour

| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Click | Alpha computed from position (horizontal: right → left increases) |
| Drag | Throttled 16ms |
| External change | Thumb syncs |

Return early when no current color exists.

## Events

```ts
picker.on('change', (color) => console.log(color)) // rgba(...)
```

## DOM

```html
<div class="ew-color-picker-slider ew-alpha ew-color-picker-is-vertical">
  <div class="ew-color-picker-alpha-slider-wrapper">
    <div class="ew-color-picker-alpha-slider-bg"></div>
    <div class="ew-color-picker-alpha-slider-bar"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="ew-color-picker-alpha-slider-thumb"></div>
</div>
```

## Example

```ts
const picker = new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  defaultColor: 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.6)',
  alphaDirection: 'horizontal',
})

picker.plugins.ewColorPickerAlpha.updateAlpha(0.5)
```

## Related

- [Hue](./hue.md) · [ColorMode](./color-mode.md)

## Box Plugin

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/box

# Box

`ewColorPickerBox` is the square trigger showing the current color.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package | `@ew-color-picker/box` |
| `pluginName` | `ewColorPickerBox` |
| `applyOrder` | not declared |
| Mount point | `root` |
| Instance | `core.plugins.ewColorPickerBox` |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultColor` | `string` | `''` | Initial color / clear target |
| `size` | string, number, object | `'normal'` | Swatch size |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Blocks clicks |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Blocks clicks, keeps styles |
| `hasBox` | `boolean` | `true` | Hide the swatch |
| `boxNoColorIcon` | `string` | `''` | Custom "no color" icon HTML |
| `boxHasColorIcon` | `string` | `''` | Custom "has color" icon HTML |
| `className` | `string` | `''` | Extra class |
| `style` | `string \| object` | `''` | Inline styles |
| `onClick` | `(box) => void` | — | Click callback |
| `onMouseEnter` / `onMouseLeave` | `(box) => void` | — | Hover callbacks |

### size

| Form | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `mini` / `small` / `normal` / `medium` / `large` | 20 / 24 / 32 / 36 / 40px |
| `48` | 48px |
| `{ width: '60px', height: '36px' }` | custom |
| `'5rem'` | verbatim |

Icon sizes: `mini` 12px, `small` 14px, `normal` 16px, `medium` 18px, `large` 20px; numbers/objects use 50% of the shorter side.

### Icon contrast

- Luminance > 0.5 → `#333333`
- otherwise → `#ffffff`
- translucent colors are blended over white first

## Methods

| Method | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enableBox` | `(enable = true) => void` | Show/hide |
| `update` | `(keys?: string[]) => void` | Refresh selected keys |
| `updateChildren` | `() => void` | Recompute icon |
| `setBoxSize` | `() => void` | Reapply size |
| `setBoxBgColor` | `(color?: string) => void` | Set background |
| `clearBoxBgColor` | `() => void` | Reset background |
| `setBoxState` | `() => void` | Sync state classes |
| `setDisabled` | `(disabled: boolean) => void` | Toggle disabled |
| `bindMouseEvents` | `(onEnter?, onLeave?) => void` | Bind hover |
| `unbindHandler` | `() => void` | Unbind DOM events |
| `destroy` | `() => void` | Remove |

Properties: `hasBox` (getter/setter), `box` (`HTMLElement | null`).

## Behaviour

Clicking calls `showPanel()` or `hidePanel()` with `togglePickerAnimation` / `pickerAnimationTime`, then `onClick(boxPlugin)`. With `disabled` or `readonly`, the click is prevented.

```ts
picker.on('toggle', (open) => console.log(open))
picker.on('change', (color) => console.log(color))
```

## DOM

```html
<div class="ew-color-picker-box">
  <span class="ew-color-picker-box-arrow-icon"></span>
</div>
```

| Class | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `.ew-color-picker-box` | Root |
| `.ew-color-picker-box-arrow-icon` | Has-color icon |
| `.ew-color-picker-box-close-icon` | No-color icon |
| `.is-disabled` / `.is-readonly` | States |

## Example

```ts
new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  defaultColor: '#6366f1',
  size: 'large',
  onClick: (box) => console.log('clicked', box.hasBox),
})
```

## Related

- [Panel](./panel.md) · [Options · size](../api/options.md#size)

## Button Plugin

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/button

# Button

`ewColorPickerButton` renders the Clear and Sure buttons. Clear restores the default color and closes the panel; Sure submits the current color and closes the panel.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package | `@ew-color-picker/button` |
| `pluginName` | `ewColorPickerButton` |
| `applyOrder` | `Post` |
| Mount point | `panelContainer` → `.ew-color-picker-bottom-row` |
| Instance | `core.plugins.ewColorPickerButton` |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `showButton` | `boolean` | `true` | Hide both buttons |
| `hasClear` | `boolean` | `true` | Hide Clear |
| `hasSure` | `boolean` | `true` | Hide Sure |
| `clearText` | `string` | `'清空'` | Clear label |
| `sureText` | `string` | `'确定'` | Sure label |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable both |

`hasClear` / `hasSure` apply at construction; use `enableClear` / `enableSure` / `enableButtons` at runtime.

## Methods

| Method / property | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enableClear` | `(enable = true) => void` | Show/hide Clear |
| `enableSure` | `(enable = true) => void` | Show/hide Sure |
| `enableButtons` | `(enable = true) => void` | Both |
| `hasClear` / `hasSure` | `boolean` getter/setter | Re-render |
| `setClearText` | `(text: string) => void` | Change label |
| `setSureText` | `(text: string) => void` | Change label |
| `setDisabled` | `(disabled: boolean) => void` | Toggle `disabled` |
| `updateOptions` | `() => void` | Re-read and redraw (deferred one frame) |
| `onClearColor` | `() => void` | Clear logic (100ms debounce) |
| `onSureColor` | `() => void` | Sure logic (100ms debounce) |
| `clearButton` / `sureButton` | `HTMLButtonElement \| null` | DOM |

## Click behaviour

### Clear

1. Restore `defaultColor`, or clear if absent;
2. Sync `hsvaColor` (reset to `{h:0,s:100,v:100,a:1}` when empty);
3. `core.setColor(resetColor)`;
4. `core.syncAllPlugins(resetColor)`;
5. `core.hidePanel()`;
6. `options.clear?.(picker)`;
7. `core.trigger('clear')`.

### Sure

1. `options.sure?.(color, picker)`;
2. `core.trigger('sure', color, picker)`;
3. `core.hidePanel()`.

## Events & callbacks

| Source | Signature |
| --- | --- |
| `options.clear` | `(picker) => void` |
| `options.sure` | `(color, picker) => void` |
| event `clear` | `()` |
| event `sure` | `(color, picker)` |

## DOM

```html
<div class="ew-color-picker-drop-btn-group">
  <button class="ew-color-picker-clear-btn ew-color-picker-drop-btn">Clear</button>
  <button class="ew-color-picker-sure-btn ew-color-picker-drop-btn">Sure</button>
</div>
```

## Example

```ts
const picker = new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  defaultColor: '#8b5cf6',
  clearText: 'Reset',
  sureText: 'Use this color',
  clear: (instance) => console.log('after clear', instance.getColor()),
  sure: (color) => console.log('confirmed', color),
})
```

## Related

- [Events · clear / sure](../api/events.md) · [Options · clearText](../api/options.md#labels)

## ColorMode Plugin

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/color-mode

# ColorMode

`ewColorPickerColorMode` provides **Hex / RGB / HSL** input modes. Switching rebuilds the channel input group.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package | `@ew-color-picker/color-mode` |
| `pluginName` | `ewColorPickerColorMode` |
| `applyOrder` | `Post` |
| Mount point | `panelContainer` |
| Instance | `core.plugins.ewColorPickerColorMode` |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultMode` | `'hex' \| 'rgb' \| 'hsl'` | `'rgb'` with Alpha, else `'hex'` | Initial mode |
| `showColorMode` | `boolean` | `true` | Hide the switcher |
| `ewColorPickerColorMode` | `boolean \| object` | `true` | `false` disables; object merges |
| `changeMode` | `(mode, picker) => void` | — | Mode change callback |

## Methods

| Method / property | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `getCurrentMode` | `() => 'hex' \| 'rgb' \| 'hsl'` | Read mode |
| `setMode` | `(mode) => void` | Switch (100ms debounce) |
| `switchToNextMode` | `() => void` | hex → rgb → hsl → hex |
| `switchToPreviousMode` | `() => void` | Reverse |
| `onModeChange` | `(mode) => void` | Main handler |
| `updateOptions` | `() => void` | Re-read config and redraw |
| `updateInputStructure` | `() => void` | Rebuild inputs |
| `updateInputValues` | `(color: string) => void` | Sync inputs |
| `updateColorFromRgbInputs` / `updateColorFromHslInputs` | `() => void` | Compose color (debounced) |
| `restoreDefaultInput` | `() => void` | Restore Input plugin field |
| `currentMode` | `'hex' \| 'rgb' \| 'hsl'` | Current mode |

## Switch flow

```text
Arrow click
  → debounce(100ms) onModeChange(mode)
  → update label (HEX / RGB / HSL)
  → updateInputStructure()
  → non-hex: updateInputValues(current color)
  → options.changeMode?.(mode, picker)
  → trigger('mode-change', mode)
```

Hex mode never calls `setColor` again, preventing hex text from being overwritten by `rgba()`.

Arrows respect `options.disabled`.

## Events & callbacks

```ts
picker.on('mode-change', (mode) => console.log(mode))
```

## DOM

```html
<div class="ew-color-picker-mode-container">
  <button class="ew-color-picker-mode-up-btn" type="button"></button>
  <div class="ew-color-picker-mode-text">HEX</div>
  <button class="ew-color-picker-mode-down-btn" type="button"></button>
</div>

<div class="ew-color-picker-inputs-group">
  <div class="ew-color-picker-inputs-col">
    <label class="ew-color-picker-input-label">R</label>
    <div class="ew-input-number">…</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Example

```ts
const picker = new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  defaultColor: '#ec4899',
  defaultMode: 'hex',
  changeMode: (mode, instance) => console.log(mode, instance.getColor()),
})

picker.plugins.ewColorPickerColorMode.setMode('hsl')
```

## Related

- [Input](./input.md) · [InputNumber](./input-number.md) · [Events](/en/api/events#mode-change)

## Console Plugin

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/console

# Console

`ewColorPickerConsole` prints a styled banner (version, QQ, WeChat, GitHub) in the browser console. It has no UI.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package | `@ew-color-picker/utils` (exports `Console`) |
| `pluginName` | `ewColorPickerConsole` |
| `applyOrder` | not declared (registered first in the bundle) |
| Mount point | none |
| Instance | `core.plugins.ewColorPickerConsole` |

## Printed once

A module-level flag ensures only the first instance prints:

```ts
let hasPrintedTips = false

run() {
  if (hasPrintedTips) return
  hasPrintedTips = true
  log(...tips)
}
```

## Disabling

Console has no options object (`{}`). To skip it, register plugins manually:

```ts
import ewColorPicker from '@ew-color-picker/core'
import Box from '@ew-color-picker/box'

ewColorPicker.use(Box) // Console not imported → no banner
```

With the all-in-one bundle it is always registered.

## Output

```text
 ew-color-picker@2.0.1   QQ: 854806732  WeChat: eveningwater  github:https://github.com/eveningwater/ew-color-picker
```

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `handleOptions` | Merge core options (no-op today) |
| `run` | Print banner (guarded) |
| `install` | Compatibility for manual `install(core)` |

## Related

- [Plugin overview](./index.md) · [Writing a plugin](../guide/plugin-dev.md)

## Hue Plugin

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/hue

# Hue

`ewColorPickerHue` renders the 0–360° hue slider while keeping saturation, value and alpha unchanged.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package | `@ew-color-picker/hue` |
| `pluginName` | `ewColorPickerHue` |
| `applyOrder` | `Post` |
| Mount point | `panelContainer` |
| Instance | `core.plugins.ewColorPickerHue` |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hue` | `boolean` | `true` | `false` hides the slider at construction |
| `hueDirection` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'vertical'` | Orientation |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Blocks interaction |

## Methods

| Method / property | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enableHue` | `(enable = true) => void` | Show/hide |
| `updateHue` | `(hue: number) => void` | Apply hue (0–360) via `setColor()` |
| `updateHueThumbPosition` | `(hue: number) => void` | Move thumb only |
| `hasHue` | `boolean` getter/setter | Re-renders on change |
| `hueBar` / `hueThumb` | `HTMLElement \| null` | DOM |
| `isHorizontal` | `boolean` | Orientation flag |

## Behaviour

| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Click | Hue computed from position, color applies |
| Drag | Throttled 16ms |
| External change | Thumb syncs to the new hue |

The gradient always shows the full spectrum.

## Events

Changes go through `core.setColor()`, so:

```ts
picker.on('change', (color) => console.log(color))
```

## DOM

```html
<div class="ew-color-picker-slider ew-color-picker-is-vertical">
  <div class="ew-color-picker-slider-bar"></div>
  <div class="ew-color-picker-slider-thumb"></div>
</div>
```

## Example

```ts
const picker = new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  defaultColor: '#ef4444',
  hueDirection: 'horizontal',
})

picker.on('change', () => console.log(picker.hsvaColor.h))
picker.plugins.ewColorPickerHue.updateHue(200)
```

## Related

- [Alpha](./alpha.md) · [Options · hueDirection](../api/options.md#huedirection--alphadirection)

## Plugin Overview

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/

# Plugin Overview

The core (`@ew-color-picker/core`) only does three things: keep color state, dispatch events, and manage mount points. **All visible UI is rendered by plugins**, so you can compose very different pickers.

## How a plugin works

| Member | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `static pluginName` | `string` | Yes |
| `static applyOrder` | `ApplyOrder` | No (`Pre = -1`, `Post = 1`) |
| `constructor(core)` | — | Yes |
| `destroy()` | `() => void` | No |

```ts
import ewColorPicker from '@ew-color-picker/core'
import MyPlugin from './my-plugin'

ewColorPicker.use(MyPlugin)
new ewColorPicker({ el: '#app' })
```

`use()` is idempotent. Plugin instances live at `core.plugins[pluginName]`.

## Built-in plugins

Registration order in `@ew-color-picker/ew-color-picker`:

| # | Plugin | `pluginName` | Package | Role |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Console | `ewColorPickerConsole` | utils | Prints the version banner once |
| 2 | Box | `ewColorPickerBox` | box | Trigger swatch |
| 3 | Panel | `ewColorPickerPanel` | panel | Saturation/value panel |
| 4 | Hue | `ewColorPickerHue` | hue | Hue slider |
| 5 | Alpha | `ewColorPickerAlpha` | alpha | Alpha slider |
| 6 | Input | `ewColorPickerInput` | input | Text color input |
| 7 | InputNumber | `ewColorPickerInputNumber` | input-number | Numeric inputs |
| 8 | Button | `ewColorPickerButton` | button | Clear / Sure |
| 9 | Predefine | `ewColorPickerPredefine` | predefine | Swatches |
| 10 | ColorMode | `ewColorPickerColorMode` | color-mode | Hex / RGB / HSL |
| 11 | — | — | style | CSS artifacts (not a plugin) |

## Mount points

| Mount point | Access | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `root` | `core.getMountPoint('root')` | `.ew-color-picker`, hosts Box |
| `panelContainer` | `core.getMountPoint('panelContainer')` | `.ew-color-picker-panel-container`, hosts everything else |

The panel container carries `ew-color-picker-panel-container-hidden` while closed.

## Collaboration

```text
User action (Box / Panel / Hue / Alpha / Input / Predefine / Button)
        │
        ▼
   core.setColor(color)   ← the only color entry
        │
        ├─► emit('change', color)
        │     ├─ Panel / Hue / Alpha / Input / ColorMode / Box sync
        │
        └─► options.changeColor(color)
```

Rules:

- Only `core.setColor()` changes color.
- Subscribe to `change`; don't poll `currentColor`.
- Read other plugin state via `core.plugins.xxx`.
- Use `core.updateOptions()` to refresh configuration.

## Trimming the UI

All plugins are registered by the bundle; disable via options instead of unregistering:

```ts
new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  hasPanel: false,
  hue: false,
  alpha: false,
  hasInput: false,
  hasClear: false,
  hasSure: false,
  showColorMode: false,
  size: 'large',
})
```

::: tip Smaller bundle
Register plugins manually — see [Installation](../guide/installation.md#per-package-imports).
:::

## Next steps

- [Box](./box.md) · [Panel](./panel.md) · [Hue](./hue.md) · [Alpha](./alpha.md)
- [Input](./input.md) · [InputNumber](./input-number.md) · [Button](./button.md)
- [Predefine](./predefine.md) · [ColorMode](./color-mode.md) · [Console](./console.md)
- [Writing a plugin](../guide/plugin-dev.md)

## InputNumber Plugin

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/input-number

# InputNumber

`@ew-color-picker/input-number` ships two pieces:

1. **Plugin** `ewColorPickerInputNumber` — creates a numeric input in the bottom row;
2. **Component** `InputNumber` — a standalone controlled number input used by ColorMode for RGB/HSL channels.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package | `@ew-color-picker/input-number` |
| `pluginName` | `ewColorPickerInputNumber` |
| `applyOrder` | `Post` |
| Mount point | `panelContainer` → `.ew-color-picker-bottom-row` |
| Instance | `core.plugins.ewColorPickerInputNumber` |

::: warning Extra stylesheet required
```ts
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/input-number.css'
```
Without it numeric inputs are unstyled.
:::

## Plugin options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable all managed inputs |

## Plugin methods

| Method | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `createInputNumber` | `(options) => InputNumber` | Create a component |
| `updateOptions` | `() => void` | Reapply `disabled` |
| `run` | `() => void` | Create the default instance |
| `destroy` | `() => void` | Destroy all instances |

## InputNumber component

```ts
import { InputNumber } from '@ew-color-picker/input-number'
```

### Options

| Option | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | `0` |
| `min` | `number` | `-Infinity` |
| `max` | `number` | `Infinity` |
| `step` | `number` | `1` |
| `precision` | `number` | `0` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` |
| `size` | `'small' \| 'default' \| 'large'` | `'default'` |
| `onChange` | `(value) => void` | — |
| `onBlur` | `(value) => void` | — |
| `onFocus` | `(event) => void` | — |

`onChange` is debounced 300ms and is **not** called during construction.

### Methods

| Method | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `getValue` | `() => number` | Read value |
| `setValue` | `(value: number) => void` | Set clamped value |
| `setDisabled` | `(disabled: boolean) => void` | Toggle disabled |
| `getElement` | `() => HTMLElement` | Root element |
| `destroy` | `() => void` | Cleanup |

### Standalone example

```ts
import { InputNumber } from '@ew-color-picker/input-number'
import '@ew-color-picker/style/dist/input-number.css'

const num = new InputNumber({
  value: 50,
  min: 0,
  max: 100,
  placeholder: 'Saturation',
  onChange: (v) => console.log(v),
})

document.body.appendChild(num.getElement())
```

## DOM

```html
<div class="ew-input-number ew-input-number--default">
  <input class="ew-input-number__input" type="text" inputmode="decimal" />
  <div class="ew-input-number__buttons">
    <button class="ew-input-number__button ew-input-number__button--up"></button>
    <button class="ew-input-number__button ew-input-number__button--down"></button>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Related

- [ColorMode](./color-mode.md) · [Input](./input.md)

## Input Plugin

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/input

# Input

`ewColorPickerInput` renders a text field accepting hex / rgb(a) / hsl(a). Valid input applies immediately; invalid input never pollutes the current color.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package | `@ew-color-picker/input` |
| `pluginName` | `ewColorPickerInput` |
| `applyOrder` | `Post` |
| Mount point | `panelContainer` |
| Instance | `core.plugins.ewColorPickerInput` |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hasInput` | `boolean` | `true` | Hide the field |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable it |
| `changeColor` | `(rgba: string) => void` | — | Applied color callback |

Display format follows the current mode: hex in Hex mode, `rgb()/rgba()` in RGB, `hsl()/hsla()` in HSL.

## Methods

| Method / property | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enableInput` | `(enable = true) => void` | Show/hide |
| `hasInput` | `boolean` getter/setter | Re-renders on change |
| `setValue` | `(value: string) => void` | Set text only |
| `getValue` | `() => string` | Read text |
| `setDisabled` | `(disabled: boolean) => void` | Toggle disabled state |
| `update` | `(color: string) => void` | Format and write current color |
| `onInputColor` | `(value: string) => void` | Input handler (300ms debounce) |
| `input` | `HTMLInputElement \| null` | DOM |

## Validation

| Input | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `#f00`, `#ff0000`, `#ff000080` | Valid |
| `rgb(255,0,0)`, `rgba(255,0,0,0.5)` | Valid |
| `hsl(0,100%,50%)`, `hsla(...)` | Valid |
| `''` | Valid (clears color) |
| other | Invalid, ignored (may warn) |

Input is debounced by 300ms.

## Events

```ts
core.setColor(rgbaColor)
core.trigger('change', rgbaColor)
options.changeColor?.(rgbaColor)
```

## DOM

```html
<div class="ew-color-picker-input-container ew-color-picker-input-container-flex">
  <input class="ew-color-picker-input" type="text" />
</div>
```

Disabled adds `ew-input-disabled`.

## Example

```ts
const picker = new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  defaultColor: '#0ea5e9',
  hasInput: true,
  changeColor: (rgba) => console.log(rgba),
})
```

## Related

- [ColorMode](./color-mode.md) · [InputNumber](./input-number.md)

## Panel Plugin

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/panel

# Panel

`ewColorPickerPanel` renders the 2D picking area. The horizontal axis is saturation, the vertical axis is value.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package | `@ew-color-picker/panel` |
| `pluginName` | `ewColorPickerPanel` |
| `applyOrder` | `Post` |
| Mount point | `panelContainer` |
| Instance | `core.plugins.ewColorPickerPanel` |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hasPanel` | `boolean` | `true` | Hide the 2D panel |
| `ewColorPickerPanel` | `boolean` | `true` | Legacy switch: `false` disables the panel; pass other panel options at the top level |
| `hueDirection` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'vertical'` | Affects width |
| `alphaDirection` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'vertical'` | Affects width |
| `autoPanelPosition` | `boolean` | `false` | Auto placement |
| `panelPlacement` | `string` | `'bottom'` | See below |
| `appendTo` | `string \| HTMLElement` | `undefined` | Mount the panel container into an external container (e.g. `document.body`) to avoid `overflow` clipping |
| `hasBox` | `boolean` | `true` | Auto placement needs the Box trigger (reads its size) |
| `alpha` | `boolean` | derived | Affects default color format |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Blocks dragging |

### panelPlacement

`top-start` `top` `top-end` `left-start` `left` `left-end` `right-start` `right` `right-end` `bottom-start` `bottom` `bottom-end`

Gap 5px; positions are adjusted to stay inside the viewport.

### Width rules

| Hue | Alpha | Width |
| --- | --- | --- |
| vertical | vertical | 285px |
| horizontal | vertical (or vice versa) | ~302px |
| horizontal | horizontal | 320px |

Height is 180px, injected as `--panel-width` / `--panel-height`.

## Methods

| Method | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `render` | `() => void` | Rebuild DOM |
| `updateCursorPosition` | `(s, v) => void` | Move cursor (0–100) |
| `updateColor` | `(s, v) => void` | Apply color via `setColor()` |
| `updateHueBg` | `(hue?) => void` | Update base hue |
| `calculateContainerSize` | `() => void` | Measure container |
| `handleAutoPosition` | `() => void` | Apply placement |
| `calculatePosition` | `(position, align, boxW, boxH) => { left, top }` | Pure calculation |
| `adjustForViewport` | `(root, left, top) => { left, top }` | Viewport correction |
| `destroy` | `() => void` | Remove |

Properties: `panel`, `cursor`, `whitePanel`, `blackPanel`, `panelWidth`, `panelHeight`, `isHueHorizontal`, `isAlphaHorizontal`, `isDragging`.

## Behaviour

| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Click | Cursor jumps, color applies |
| Drag | Throttled to ~60fps |
| Touch | Same as drag |
| External change | Cursor and base hue sync |

`updateColor` falls back to red when the current color is empty or contains `NaN`.

Emits `change` via `core.setColor()`.

## DOM

```html
<div class="ew-color-picker-panel ew-color-picker-panel-dynamic-size"
     style="--panel-width:285px;--panel-height:180px">
  <div class="ew-color-picker-white-panel"></div>
  <div class="ew-color-picker-black-panel"></div>
  <div class="ew-color-picker-panel-cursor"></div>
</div>
```

## Example

```ts
const picker = new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  hueDirection: 'horizontal',
  alphaDirection: 'horizontal',
  autoPanelPosition: true,
  panelPlacement: 'bottom-start',
})

picker.plugins.ewColorPickerPanel.updateColor(20, 30)
```

## Related

- [Hue](./hue.md) · [Alpha](./alpha.md) · [Options · panelPlacement](../api/options.md#panelplacement)

## Predefine Plugin

Source: https://eveningwater.github.io/ew-color-picker/en/plugins/predefine

# Predefine

`ewColorPickerPredefine` renders a row of quick color swatches inside the panel.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package | `@ew-color-picker/predefine` |
| `pluginName` | `ewColorPickerPredefine` |
| `applyOrder` | not declared |
| Mount point | `panelContainer` |
| Instance | `core.plugins.ewColorPickerPredefine` |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `predefineColor` | `(string \| { color: string; disabled?: boolean })[]` | `[]` | Swatches; empty renders nothing |
| `changeColor` | `(rgba: string) => void` | — | Swatch applied |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Block all clicks |

```ts
predefineColor: [
  '#ef4444',
  { color: '#22c55e', disabled: true },
  '#3b82f6',
]
```

Strict color validation: invalid entries are filtered out before rendering and re-checked on click.

## Methods

| Method / property | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `updatePredefineColors` | `(colors) => void` | Replace and re-render |
| `setDisabled` | `(index: number, disabled: boolean) => void` | Toggle one swatch |
| `onPredefineColorClick` | `(event, color) => void` | Click handler (100ms debounce) |
| `predefineItems` | `HTMLElement[]` | Swatch DOM |
| `container` | `HTMLElement \| null` | Container |

## Click behaviour

Checks the disabled class and global `disabled`, highlights the active swatch, validates and converts the color, syncs `core.hsvaColor`, calls `core.setColor(rgba)`, then `options.changeColor?.(rgba)`.

## Events

```ts
picker.on('change', (color) => console.log(color))
```

## DOM

```html
<div class="ew-color-picker-predefine-container">
  <div class="ew-color-picker-predefine-color">
    <div class="ew-color-picker-predefine-color-item" style="background:#ef4444"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="ew-color-picker-predefine-color ew-color-picker-predefine-color-disabled">…</div>
  <div class="ew-color-picker-predefine-color ew-color-picker-predefine-color-active">…</div>
</div>
```

## Example

```ts
new ewColorPicker({
  el: '#app',
  defaultColor: '#3b82f6',
  predefineColor: ['#ef4444', '#f97316', '#eab308', '#22c55e', '#3b82f6', '#a855f7'],
  changeColor: (rgba) => console.log(rgba),
})
```

- [Options · predefineColor](../api/options.md#predefinecolor) · [Styles](../api/styles.md)
